description: Orientation for wiring a redu.cloud capability (backups, DNS, extra storage, a managed DB, ...) INTO an app already deployed on redu, e.g. 'add a backup feature to the Supabase I deployed on redu'. Explains the pattern: mint a LEAST-PRIVILEGE scoped API key (with the user's approval via create_api_key), inject it into the app, and call the redu API from the app. Call this when a user asks to add/integrate a redu feature into a running deployment and you are unsure how.
name: integrate_overview
title: How to add a redu capability to an app you deployed (start here)
